get.description: Downloads a PDF or CSV of the RFIs List

parameters.name: export_format
parameters.description: File format for the export - 'pdf' or 'csv'.

parameters.name: table_configuration_for_export
parameters.description:
Table configuration for the export that controls which columns are visible and their order in the generated PDF or CSV.

When provided, the export will respect both the column visibility settings and the column order from the frontend table configuration.
Columns marked as `hidden: true` will be excluded from the export, and visible columns will appear in the same order 
as specified in the columnState array.

If this parameter is not provided, the export will use default column visibility and order based on configurable field sets.

schema.description: Table configuration object containing column state information

columnState.description: Array of column configuration objects that determines both visibility and order of columns in the export

field.description: The field name/identifier for the column. The order of fields in the array determines the column order in the export.

hidden.description: Whether the column should be hidden in the export

schema.example:
#,Created By,Initiated At,Assigned,Due Date,Subject,Responsible Contractor,Received From,Cost Impact,Cost Impact Value,Schedule Impact,Schedule Impact Value,Drawing Number,Reference,Closed Date,Cost Code,Location,Closed?,Ball In Court,Latest Assignee Response Date,Private,"",""

400.description: Bad Request - returned when an unsupported `export_format` is provided (only `pdf` and `csv` are accepted).

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

x-changelog.summary: Improved error response for invalid export_format on RFI list export
x-changelog.description: The RFIs list export endpoint now returns a 400 Bad Request with a clear validation message when an unsupported `export_format` is provided. Only `csv` and `pdf` are accepted. Previously, unsupported values caused a 500 Internal Server Error.

x-changelog.summary: Documented table_configuration_for_export on the RFI export endpoint
x-changelog.description: The RFI export documentation now describes the `table_configuration_for_export` parameter, which controls which columns appear in the generated PDF or CSV and in what order. When omitted, the export falls back to default column visibility and ordering.
